column3: Super+G opens a bench of tools: a clock, a timer, your network and resources, pinned where you leave them.
Pin a whole window or a part of one; it keeps playing on your desktop, here in Waffle.
Choosing a file, a folder or a colour opens the shell's own picker, in your scheme, never a white window.
A widget from the Hub sits as a card in the left sidebar or a tab in the right one; the Countdown is the first.
